testCases.input: What is online eval and how is it different from offline eval?
testCases.expectedOutput: Online eval is evaluating your system on live production traffic after deployment, as real users interact with it. Its biggest characteristic is that it works without an answer key or golden dataset—you have to estimate on the go what the right answer could be. It runs continuously after deployment on whatever questions real users ask, which you cannot anticipate in advance. The key distinction is that offline eval checks whether your application is working correctly, whereas online eval tells you whether your application is running normally in production. The two are not rivals or replacements—they are complementary and are meant to be used together.
